title: The Only One

lines.text: How do I compare to your past girlfriends?
You're the only one I've been with!
The others were all eights and nines.

notes: 'The only one' rebuilt as 'единственная — единица', so the compliment turns into a score of one; the eights and nines then make the scale clear.
title: Единственная

lines.text: Как я по сравнению с твоими бывшими?
Ты у меня единственная — единица!
А остальные все были восьмёрки и девятки.

notes: 'The only one' rebuilt as 'die Einzige — eine glatte Eins'; it first sounds like a top school grade, then the eights and nines reveal the one-to-ten scale.

lines.text: Wie schneide ich im Vergleich zu deinen Ex-Freundinnen ab?

lines.text: Two young boys walked into a pharmacy, picked out a box of tampons, and proceeded to the checkout counter.
Son, how old are you?
Eight.
Do you know what these are used for?
Not exactly, but they aren't for me.
They're for him... He's my brother. He's four.
We saw on TV that if you use these, you will be able to swim and ride a bike.
Right now, he can't do either.

lines.text: Двое мальчишек зашли в аптеку, взяли коробку тампонов и пошли к кассе.

title: Abe Lincoln

lines.text: A father thought his son was spending too much time playing computer games, so he stopped him.
Son, when Abe Lincoln was your age, he was studying books by the light of the fireplace.
Yeah, well, when Abe Lincoln was your age, he was The President of the United States.

notes: Kept Lincoln: he is known in Russia and the source names him; swapping in a local figure would add a real person the joke doesn't have.
title: Авраам Линкольн

lines.text: Отец решил, что сын слишком много играет в компьютерные игры, и остановил его.
Сынок, когда Авраам Линкольн был в твоём возрасте, он читал книги при свете камина.
Ага. А когда Авраам Линкольн был в твоём возрасте, он был президентом Соединённых Штатов.

notes: Line-by-line translation; Lincoln kept.

Ja, schon, und als Abraham Lincoln in deinem Alter war, war er Präsident der Vereinigten Staaten.
